biggest_catch: You only get paid if your friend actually joins Star One Credit Union AND opens a checking account; a friend who only opens a savings account or doesn't use your share link earns you nothing.
catches: Referred friend must open BOTH a new Membership Savings and a Checking account with Star One Credit Union.
Referral limited to 3 paid new members per referrer ($300 max in gift cards).
Friend gets a reward too, but the page does not state its amount — the referrer's reward is the stated $100 gift card.
Terms/promotion end date not stated on the referral page; Star One may change or end the program at any time.
Tax treatment not stated; treat as potentially reportable income.
